Ijaye road is busy due to alternation and return journey influx. Guinness inward Akanni Doherty down to Mangoro Ashade is moving fast. Capitol inward Oniwaya junction down to Alfa Nla is steady. 
Old Ipaja road and Old Abeokuta road are busy due to alternation, but some sections are moving fast. No impediments reported, and traffic officials are on ground managing the situation.

#FollowLASTMA

[7:46PM] #Dopemu #TrafficUpdate 

Good vehicular movement from Cement inward Dopemu underneath the bridge to Adealu Goye intersection inward Alaguntan Alimosho road.

Akiwowo, Cash Street, and Moshalashi are experiencing good traffic flow in both directions. Dopemu bridge inward Akowonjo roundabout, ShaSha, Cele, Shobo, Kwara, Jimoh, and Vulcanizer are all moving smoothly. 

However, approaching Micom is slow.
Traffic is busy from Bakery, Ogunlana junction to Egbeda due to commercial activities. 

The return journey from Egbeda to Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway and Babajide Sanwo-Olu road to Agbotikuyo is calm. 
Oniwaya road is good.
No impediments have been reported, and our officers are on ground managing the situation.

#FollowLASTMA

[8:12PM] #Marina #TrafficUpdate 

Good vehicular movement from UBA roundabout towards NNPC filling station and from Cathedral Church down to Nitel intersection. 
There's uninterrupted movement from State House frontage to McWen Bridge connecting Force Road. 
Traffic is flowing well from Onikan roundabout towards TBS and Water Board connecting Nitel intersection. 
The stretch from Zone 2 underneath the bridge to Flagstaff House, McWen Bridge, Officers Mess, and Bonny Camp is moving perfectly. Broad Street, Bookshop, Tinubu Square, Abibu Oki, Martins Junction, and Davies Street are all looking good.
There's slow and steady movement after Balogun traffic light towards Apongbon underneath due to commercial activities. Igbosere Road and Catholic Mission Street connecting Ganiu Smith Street are moving well. Our personnel are visible, monitoring the situation, and there's no impediment reported.

#FollowLASTMA

🇵🇭 Earthquake aftermath on Mindanao: magnitude 7.4, flooding and building damage, October 10, 2025

🌍 On October 10, a powerful magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck the island of Mindanao (Philippines). According to meteorologists, the epicenter was offshore, and tremors were felt across the region.
🌊 Water poured into coastal areas, and several vehicles were submerged. Fire Chief Jardar Afret reported that water likely entered at least one building.
🆘 Emergency crews are working to assess the damage and assist affected residents.

⏰ Since the end of 2024 our planet has entered  the 12,000-year cycle. We as humanity are not ready for this, neither scientifically, nor technically or in terms of morality and humaneness. But we still have a little bit of time left to curb the climatic Cerberus....  🌀
